question.text: Jaya is assessing an AIF's Investor Advisory Committee / LP Advisory Board. Its primary role is:

answer.text: Making investment decisions on behalf of the fund manager
Managing the fund's daily trading operations
Providing recommendations on conflicts of interest, risk management, governance matters, investor-manager relations and reporting, statutory or tax issues, and administrative fund-document matters
Conducting marketing campaigns for the fund

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook describes the Investor Advisory Committee / LP Advisory Board as a governance check whose recommendations may cover conflict resolution, risk management, governance matters, investor-manager relations and reporting, statutory or tax issues, and related administrative fund matters. The Trap: The advisory body does not make investment decisions (the IC does) or run daily operations, and marketing is not a governance function. Note: Based on workbook pages 158, 181, 193, and 215-216 covering investor advisory bodies.
